name: claude-code-extras
displayName: Claude Code Extras for VS Code
description: Interface additions for the Claude Code chat panel in VS Code: real timestamps, per-reply duration, context share and estimated spend, sub-agent tags, a view filter for main thread vs each sub-agent, a table of contents of your own messages, and a chime when a turn finishes.

claudeCodeExtras.enabled.markdownDescription: Show what this extension adds to the panel: a timestamp on every message and content block, a line on each reply with its duration, context share, estimated cost and model, and a name tag on sub-agent messages. Off leaves those out and the panel reads as Claude Code renders it. The **Extras: On/Off** status bar item is the same setting. Changes apply live, without a reload.

claudeCodeExtras.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the **Extras: On/Off** toggle in the status bar.

claudeCodeExtras.userMessageColor.markdownDescription: Text color of **your own messages** in the Claude Code panel, as a CSS color — e.g. `#90EE90`, `lightgreen` or `rgb(144,238,144)`. Leave empty to keep the panel's own color. Changes apply live.

claudeCodeExtras.userMessageEdge.markdownDescription: Mark **your own messages** in the Claude Code panel with a bar down their left edge, in the theme's focus colour. The panel already outlines them, but in most themes that outline lands within a shade of the editor background, so a question and a reply read as one stream. Off leaves the panel's own outline alone. Changes apply live.
